text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Prime Minister Eddie Fenech Adami holds election campaign television debate with opposition Labour leader Alfred Sant. Fenech says his party is the only guarantee for peaceful, prosperous future. Sant hit out at corruption, rise in crime.
- Adami delivers knockout blow to Sant in Tuesday's TV duel.
- Prime Minister Adami appears desperate and tired as he faces Labour leader Sant in TV debate.
